- **Re: Guidelines on Group Health Insurance Policies upon Merger of Public Sector Banks (PSBs)** Consequent to the merger of few PSBs, in order to protect the interests of the group insurance policyholders of the merged banks, the following guidelines are issued. 

- Upon merger of these PSBs, the underlying group health Insurance policies of the customers of the merged banks shall continue to be serviced by the respective

   - also offer this insurance coverage to the customers of the merged bank with the consent of its insurer.
